$comment: Organization-level provider keys (Organization > Providers > Inference), then enabled for the workspace (Workspaces > rogueproof > Providers). Names only; the key values are entered once in the dashboard and never stored in this repo. Enabling an own key for a provider replaces the hosted copy for that provider ('Not used, your key serves this provider'). Organization > Providers > Inference lists each key with Serving (models the key can serve, e.g. together-own 51 of 269), the API key's last 4 chars, API base, and a star marking the org default per provider.
